name: Startup India Initiative

ministry.name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
ministry.department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

overview: A flagship initiative to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups, offering DPIIT recognition, tax exemptions, easier compliance and access to funding and incubation support.
objectives: Provide access to funding, mentorship and incubation support

benefits.title: Tax Exemption
benefits.description: Income tax exemption for eligible DPIIT-recognised startups for a specified period

benefits.title: Self-Certification
benefits.description: Compliance simplification through self-certification for labour and environment laws

otherCriteria: Entity incorporated as a private limited company, LLP or registered partnership firm, not older than 10 years, with turnover below the prescribed limit

customQuestions.question: Is your entity incorporated or registered in India?
Is the entity incorporated as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or Partnership Firm?
Was the entity incorporated within the prescribed period for Startup recognition?

Is the entity working towards innovation, development or improvement of products, processes or services, or does it have a scalable business model with high potential for employment generation or wealth creation?
Does the entity's turnover remain within the prescribed Startup India limit for the applicable recognition period?
Was the entity not formed by splitting up or reconstructing an existing business?
Is the entity not a subsidiary of another company?
Is the entity not formed through merger or demerger/reconstruction of an existing business, except where specifically permitted?
Are you seeking DPIIT Startup Recognition?

applicationProcess.description: Register the entity on the Startup India portal
Apply for DPIIT recognition with required documents
Access tax, funding and compliance benefits

faqs.question: What is DPIIT recognition?
faqs.answer: An official status granted to eligible startups enabling access to scheme benefits.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for registration?
faqs.answer: No, registration on the Startup India portal is free.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
ministry.department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

overview: A scheme providing financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialisation.
objectives: Provide seed capital to startups at an early stage
Support proof of concept and prototype development
Facilitate market entry and initial commercialisation

benefits.title: Seed Grant
benefits.description: Grant funding for proof of concept, prototyping and product trials through selected incubators

benefits.title: Debt/Convertible Funding
benefits.description: Investment for market entry and commercialisation through selected incubators

otherCriteria: DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated not more than 2 years before applying

customQuestions.question: Is your startup recognized by DPIIT?
Was your startup incorporated not more than 2 years before the date of application?
Does your startup have a business idea with market fit, viable commercialization and potential for scaling?
Does your startup use technology in its core product/service or business model?
Is your startup developing a product or service capable of addressing a market need?
Has your startup received more than Γé╣10 lakh in monetary support from another Central or State Government scheme?
Is the startup applying as a DPIIT-recognized startup rather than an individual entrepreneur?
Are you willing to apply through an eligible incubator selected under SISFS?

applicationProcess.description: Apply through an eligible incubator on the Seed Fund portal
Selected startups receive seed funding as grant/debt instrument

faqs.question: Who disburses the seed fund?
faqs.answer: Selected incubators empanelled under the scheme.

faqs.question: What is the funding used for?
faqs.answer: Proof of concept, prototype development, product trials and market entry.

name: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
overview: The Government of India's flagship initiative to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship, supporting Atal Tinkering Labs in schools and Atal Incubation Centres for startups.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship culture across India
Establish tinkering labs to foster innovation among school students
Support incubation centres for startups and entrepreneurs

benefits.title: Atal Tinkering Labs
benefits.description: Funding and support for setting up innovation labs in schools

benefits.title: Atal Incubation Centres
benefits.description: Financial support for setting up incubation infrastructure for startups

otherCriteria: Schools for Atal Tinkering Labs; incubators/institutions for Atal Incubation Centres

applicationProcess.description: Eligible institutions apply through the AIM portal call for proposals
Proposals evaluated by AIM Mission Directorate

faqs.question: What is an Atal Tinkering Lab?
faqs.answer: A dedicated innovation workspace set up in schools to nurture curiosity among students.

faqs.question: Who can apply for Atal Incubation Centre support?
faqs.answer: Eligible institutions and organisations as per AIM's call for proposals.

name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
ministry.department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) / SIDBI

overview: A fund managed by SIDBI that invests in SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds, which in turn provide equity funding to DPIIT-recognised startups, catalysing domestic capital availability.
objectives: Catalyse availability of domestic capital for startups
Encourage participation of alternative investment funds in startup financing
Reduce dependence on foreign capital for Indian startups

benefits.title: Indirect Equity Funding
benefits.description: Startups receive equity investment through SEBI-registered AIFs that are contributed to by the Fund of Funds

otherCriteria: DPIIT-recognised startups seeking equity funding through participating AIFs

customQuestions.question: Is your business an officially DPIIT-recognized startup?
Is your startup incorporated/registered in India?
Is your startup working towards innovation, development or improvement of products, processes or services, or does it have a scalable model with high potential for employment/wealth creation?
Is your startup within the current Startup India recognition period?
Is your startup seeking equity/equity-linked venture capital investment rather than a direct government grant?
Are you willing to seek investment through a SEBI-registered AIF/venture fund participating in the FFS ecosystem?
Does your startup satisfy the investment criteria of the particular AIF/fund?

applicationProcess.description: Startup approaches a SEBI-registered AIF that has received FFS contribution
AIF evaluates the startup for investment
Equity funding provided by the AIF to the selected startup

faqs.question: Does the government invest directly in startups under FFS?
faqs.answer: No, the government invests in AIFs, which then invest in startups.

faqs.question: Who manages the Fund of Funds?
faqs.answer: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
ministry.department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) / National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company

overview: A scheme providing credit guarantee cover to loans extended by member institutions to DPIIT-recognised startups, enabling them to access debt funding without collateral.
objectives: Facilitate collateral-free debt funding for startups
Provide credit guarantee cover to lending institutions
Encourage formal lending to the startup ecosystem

benefits.title: Credit Guarantee Cover
benefits.description: Guarantee cover on loans extended to DPIIT-recognised startups by eligible member institutions

otherCriteria: DPIIT-recognised startups seeking working capital or term loans from eligible member institutions

customQuestions.question: Is your business a DPIIT-recognized startup?
Is the startup incorporated/registered in India?
Is the startup seeking a loan/debt facility from an eligible Member Institution (MI)?
Is the proposed credit facility being used for a business purpose of the startup?
Is the proposed loan within the maximum credit facility covered under CGSS?
Is the startup not in default/NPA with the lending institution at the time of guarantee coverage?
Is the startup willing to provide the security/collateral required under the applicable lending arrangement, if applicable?
Is the startup applying through an eligible Member Institution, rather than directly applying to NCGTC for the guarantee?

applicationProcess.description: Startup applies for a loan with an eligible member institution
Lending institution avails guarantee cover under CGSS
Loan disbursed to the startup based on approval

faqs.question: Is collateral required?
faqs.answer: The guarantee cover reduces the need for collateral, subject to the lender's policy.

faqs.question: Who provides the guarantee?
faqs.answer: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Ltd. on behalf of the government.
